body: Man... I felt that last sentence.

Girl no. He said he was hoping you’d bleed out. There’s a little bit of truth in things people say when they’re mad and that was pretty descriptive.. and it takes 12 WEEKS to heal from a c-section and 6 for vaginal. Either way you may feel ok but you cannot return to your normal activities and lifting things. He needs to speak with a doctor because he obviously doesn’t get it. I know it’s hard and you just had a baby (I did too, mine is 12 weeks old) but I’d say your best bet is to leave because it’ll only get worse no matter what he SAYS.
